note: All prices USD per million tokens. Anthropic cache writes are priced by TTL: 1.25x input for the 5-minute cache, 2x input for the 1-hour cache. Cache reads are 0.1x input at either TTL. claude-sonnet-5 is $2/$10: the rate announced at launch as introductory through 2026-08-31 became the standard price, and the scheduled increase to $3/$15 was cancelled. context_window is input tokens; a document larger than it cannot run the full-context or cached approaches on that model. Update this file and re-run precompute when prices drift; the UI displays snapshot_date.
note_snapshot_dates: snapshot_date is when the Anthropic rates were last read. An entry may carry its own rates_snapshot_date when it was read on a different day; that one wins for that model. Adding a provider must never restate another provider's rates as freshly verified.
note_cache_styles: cache is how the provider exposes prompt caching, and it decides which cached-context arms a model can run. 'explicit_ttl': the request chooses a lifetime, so both cached_context_5m and cached_context_1h are measurable, each paying its own write premium. 'auto': the provider caches every prompt automatically at one undisclosed lifetime with no write premium and no opt-out, so the two TTL variants collapse into cached_context_auto and there are no cache_write rates to quote. Arms that must not read a warm cache send a unique isolation key per request instead (see arms/openai_compat.py).
